resource: Bestiary races in one BestiaryViewV1, and the largest race index
allocation_impact: The decoder refuses the 1025th entry or a race index above 1024 before allocating for it; the whole view is at most 21504 bytes (state domain 4). A server view over the bound is a server fault and is never truncated.
boundary_tests: max=1024: a view of 1024 races at race index 1024 encodes and decodes
max+1=1025: a 1025th entry or race index 1025 is refused in both directions
notes: 833 Bestiary races in the captured staticdata (CHARM-0 section 2). CHARM-5 proposal section 2; accepted by the Sol protocol ruling #162 5907282001. Registered by OTV2-20260930-charm-5-reg.
